d: Pakistan is expanding its drone arsenal with 100,000 Turkish Merkut FPV attack drones, unmanned helicopters and kamikaze surveillance systems, raising questions about its military ambitions and growing defence ties with Turkey after the Mecca Defence Pact. Meanwhile, China’s alleged espionage network is back in focus, from honey traps and romantic relationships to economic espionage and intelligence operations involving the Ministry of State Security and the United Front Work Department. From Asim Munir’s drone deal with Recep Tayyip Erdogan to Beijing’s alleged use of covert influence…
